summary: The candidate requires application/json bodies, enforces hub-origin and per-session CSRF checks for authenticated password registration, and rejects password replacement from sessions older than the configured 12-hour window. The added tests cover same-site sibling text/plain and cross-origin JSON attempts plus stale-session rejection.

evidence: src/passport.ts:761-793 obtains the hub session, requires its per-session CSRF token and hub origin for authenticated registration, and rejects stale sessions with recent_authentication_required before saving a replacement password.
src/http.ts:142-145 rejects non-application/json bodies, blocking text/plain mutations before credential changes.
public/auth.js:383-390 sends the session CSRF token with password/register requests.
tests/worker_runtime.mjs:780-793 and src/handler_test.ts:4892-4964 exercise same-site sibling origin and stale-session password replacement attempts.
